reason: The cited evidence supports sigma phase coarsening at grain boundaries above ~950 K and AM-induced nitride/sigma precipitation, but provides no data or discussion on the effect of oxidizing versus reducing atmospheres on precipitate kinetics, which is a central premise of the hypothesis.
premises: Sigma phase coarsens and segregates to grain boundaries above ~950 K
AM process (SLM with N2) induces fine nitride and sigma precipitates in as-built state
Precipitate size increases with annealing temperature
Oxygen accelerates precipitate growth kinetics relative to reducing atmospheres
